original_question:
Design the following two Verilog modules:

1.  `full_adder`: A combinational logic module that takes three single-bit inputs (`a`, `b`, `cin`) and produces a single-bit sum (`sum`) and a single-bit carry-out (`cout`).
2.  `ripple_carry_adder`: A combinational logic module that takes two 4-bit inputs (`a`, `b`) and a single-bit carry-in (`cin`), and produces a 4-bit sum (`sum`) and a single-bit carry-out (`cout`). This module should be implemented using the `full_adder` module designed in step 1, connected in a ripple-carry configuration.

Ensure the module names and port names exactly match those specified above.
